turns.prompt: I want an original virtual storyteller outfit inspired by the kimono's quiet main fabric and red boundary, not a recreated kimono. Give me A and B as two different silhouette directions. Each sheet should show the same character from front, back, and with one arm raised, plus a face-and-shoulder 160x160 preview. The face must remain the main focus. A folded side panel should visibly attach at the wearer's left waist, and the back view should keep that same body-side ownership even though screen left and right reverse. Keep the shoulder outline quiet enough for a small talking-head stream. Explain which attachment and material ideas are visible in the drawings and which would need a real rig or cloth test. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

Choose A for the folded panel, not the large sleeves. Keep B unchanged. Make the lower silhouette feel fuller by adjusting the panel's fold and overlap, without widening the shoulders or covering the hands. Keep the face, red-edge palette, and waist attachment location. Show the same three views and thumbnail. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.

I meant lighter material, not a more transparent or wider panel. Change only the fold highlight, edge weight, and overlap cues while preserving the accepted silhouette and attachment. In the raised-arm view make the underarm transition understandable without pretending this proves deformation. Do not call the drawing a finished Live2D or VRM model. Deliver a.svg, a.png, b.svg, b.png, thumb.svg, thumb.png, notes.md. Keep these filenames on every turn. PNG previews must use the declared dimensions; include actual rendered results, not an empty placeholder. PNG sizes: 160x160, 960x720.
